stem.text: The infra-red spectrum of compound $P$ is shown.

stem.alt: Infra-red spectrum: transmittance (%) against wavenumber (cm-1) from 4000 to 500, with a broad absorption around 3300 cm-1, sharp absorptions near 3000 cm-1 and between 1500 and 500 cm-1, and no strong absorption near 1700 cm-1.
